snp3.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane …pe…
snp3.3:2.1: catūhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatā vācā subhāsitā hoti na dubbhāsitā, anavajjā ca ananuvajjā ca viññūnaṃ,
snp3.3:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu subhāsitaṃ yeva bhāsati no dubbhāsitaṃ dhammaṃ yeva bhāsati no adhammaṃ, piyaṃ yeva bhāsati no appiyaṃ, sacca yeva bhāsati no alikaṃ.
snp3.3:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi aṅgehi samannāgatā vācā subhāsitā hoti na dubbhāsitā, anavajjā ca ananuvajjā ca viññūnanti.
snp3.3:2.6: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
snp3.3:4.1: atha kho āyasmā vaṃgīso upaṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
snp3.3:4.2: paṭibhāti maṃ bhagavā paṭibhāti maṃ bhagavāti.
snp3.3:4.4: atha kho āyasmā vaṃgīso bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi.
